knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A defensible plan is written, scored, reasoned and complete, with a rescue arrangement and stop conditions. A verbal agreement and a list of equipment are not enough.
The residual score reflects the control only once it is in place and verified. A planned control is not yet a control.
A plan that depends on a licence the worker does not hold cannot be depended on. The licence position must be confirmed first.

practicalCriteria: Completes a risk assessment for a supplied height task, with each position, hazard, score and reason
Chooses the highest feasible control for each hazard, and records each higher level rejected
Returns a supplied incomplete plan with the specific gaps named
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed risk assessment for a supplied task
Assessor review of the scoring and the controls
stopWorkCriteria: A plan with no rescue arrangement is not approved for height work
A plan that relies on a licence the worker does not hold is not approved until the licence is confirmed
